notes: Signature is the INK: a warm desaturated taupe #67645e used as the universal 'black' for text, icons, and 1px hairline borders — never true #000. Surfaces alternate pure white cards over a warm grey-tint panel #f1f0ed. One reserved chromatic accent: chocolate #643a2a (the 'bronze' product + the giant footer wordmark). Blue #007aff and red #d50430 are OS/sale incidentals, dropped from the palette. Borders are drawn as `inset 0 0 0 1px` box-shadows (signature, 530+ hits) so the hairline never shifts layout. Radius is pill-dominant: 40px (892 hits) for buttons/cards, 50% for circular chips. Two families: Swiss (neutral grotesque, all body/UI, 16px with +0.02em tracking) + Rektorat Heavy (heavy rounded grotesque for the lowercase wordmark + display). H1 wordmark 176px desktop / 85.8px mobile, tracked tight (-0.04em). Raw fontSize noise (16.88/16.2px) rounded to 16px. Motion normalized to a calm, reduced-motion-respected set: staggered fade + 1.03→1 settle-scale on reveal, nav color-shift white→taupe over the dark hero, Swiper product/social carousels; GSAP drives it via scroll listeners (no IntersectionObserver observed).
